headline: Buffalo lays three, and Cook is the first job

sectionTitles.lastGame: What the 34-7 Arrowhead afternoon actually showed

dek: Kansas City is 8-2 and goes to Buffalo on Thu Nov 26, 7:20 PM CT on NBC as a DraftKings three-point underdog on a 46.5 total, with ESPN FPI at 46.6 percent after a 34-7 win over Arizona.
videoHook: Buffalo is laying three on Thanksgiving, James Cook is the assignment Chris Jones already named, and 8-2 does not buy a free point.
theEdge: ESPN FPI lists Kansas City at 46.6 percent in Buffalo against 53.1 for the Bills, DraftKings has Buffalo minus 3 on a 46.5 total, and the Arrowhead afternoon that travels with them was 118 rushing yards, 317 net passing yards, 7-of-13 on third down, and zero giveaways.
editorNotes: Attribute 317 net passing, 435 total, 10 drives, and 32:26 to KC; ARI is 130, 205, 9 drives, 27:34.
Mahomes passing line is 3 TD, not 2. Scoring table: KC TDs 8, 3, 22, 18 and FGs 40 and 44; ARI TD 2. Avoid the phrase four touchdowns.
Fumble at Q3 10:30 forced by G.Karlaftis, recovered by ARZ-J.Fryar; both boxes list 0 turnovers.
Last-game window is midday; do not use the words night or nights. O/U is 46.5.

storyline.lede: The next game is Buffalo, not a victory lap. Kansas City is 8-2, DraftKings has the Bills minus 3 on a 46.5 total, and ESPN FPI has Buffalo at 53.1 percent to Kansas City's 46.6. Arrowhead Pride's Kingdom Keys frame it as a rivalry Buffalo has owned in the regular season: five consecutive regular-season wins and a 5-1 edge before January in the Mahomes-Allen era. Thu Nov 26, 7:20 PM CT on NBC is the assignment.
body: The supporting tape is the 34-7 Arrowhead afternoon against Arizona. Patrick Mahomes was 27-of-39 for 324 yards and 3 touchdowns with a 120.0 rating, one sack, and five quarterback hits. Arizona managed 14 first downs, 75 rushing yards, 130 net passing yards, 205 total yards, 5-of-13 on third down, nine drives, and 27:34. That is a clean afternoon. It is not a blueprint for Josh Allen and James Cook.

Chris Jones has already set the defensive priority: stopping James Cook is the No. 1 goal, per Arrowhead Pride, in what will be his 10th meeting with Allen across the regular season and playoffs, a ledger in which Jones has one sack and three tackles for loss. Spagnuolo can live with that individual sack line if the fits take the run away and the coverage shell keeps Allen from stacking explosives.

The roster is moving while the schedule hardens. Kenneth Walker returned limited on the Tuesday injury report. Fred Johnson was signed to the active roster after a week on the practice squad, with tackle depth the stated concern. Eric Bieniemy has a two-back conversation to manage if Walker is available, with Emmett Johnson coming off 23 carries, 105 yards, and a touchdown. Arrowhead Pride has the club tied with Denver for the AFC West lead and the Broncos holding a slight edge, so a road underdog result in Buffalo changes the West math before the Thursday trip to the Rams.

lastGameReview.label: Week 11 · Sun, Nov 22 · 12:00 PM CT
lastGameReview.lede: Kansas City beat Arizona 34-7 at Arrowhead on Sun Nov 22, 12:00 PM CT. Emmett Johnson's 3-yard run at Q1 0:48 made it 14-0. Arizona answered with a 2-yard touchdown at Q2 9:48 to make it 14-7. Kansas City then added a 40-yard field goal, Travis Kelce's 22-yard touchdown at Q2 1:54, a 44-yard field goal at the half, and an 18-yard touchdown at Q4 14:54.

analysis.body: The run game was Johnson's afternoon, not a committee showcase. He had 23 rushes and 4 catches, 27 touches, 105 yards, and the 3-yard score up the middle at Q1 0:48. The early script put him on the edge and inside: a 16-yard right-end gain on the first snap of the series at Q1 14:55, then a string of up-the-middle carries that moved the chains into the red zone. Jaydn Ott finished with 5 rushes, Nate Carter 1, and Justin Fields 2 rushes plus an 0-of-1 throw. That is a defined lead back, with the change-of-pace work arriving after the game was in hand.

Mahomes' 27-of-39, 324-yard, 3-touchdown line sat on top of a team net of 317 passing yards. Kelce had 6 catches for 74 yards and 2 touchdowns, including the 22-yard score down the middle at Q2 1:54. Rashee Rice also had 6 catches, Josh Downs 4, Noah Gray 3, Cyrus Allen 2 — including a 26-yard catch to the Arizona 18 at Q3 0:04 — and Xavier Worthy 2. The miss that shows up on the penalty list is intentional grounding on Mahomes at Q2 0:16, enforced at the Arizona 16, before an incompletion to Worthy. One sack and five quarterback hits is the pressure count. It is not a messy pocket tape.

Steve Spagnuolo's group held Arizona to 205 yards and 5-of-13 on third down. Josh Johnson was 18-of-31 with 3 sacks and an 82.1 rating. George Karlaftis was credited with 2.5 sacks and, at Q3 10:30, forced a fumble on a 9-yard sack that J. Fryar recovered for Arizona. The box lists zero turnovers for both teams, so that strip stayed with the offense. Trey McBride still got 10 touches (1 rush, 9 catches) in a game the visitors could not sustain. Bam Knight had 8 touches, Tyler Allgeier 7 rushes. Arizona also failed on downs at Q2 3:05 and Q4 4:04. Kansas City recorded 7 quarterback hits.

Third down was 7-of-13, a real step from the Atlanta game's 4-of-13, and it should be kept on that prior tape rather than blended into this box. The afternoon closed 34-7. The leverage question for Buffalo is whether 118 team rushing yards and a defined Johnson workload still travel when the back on the other sideline is James Cook.

takeaways.title: Johnson was the carry count
takeaways.body: Twenty-three rushes, four catches, 105 yards, and the 3-yard score at Q1 0:48. Ott, Carter, and Fields were complementary touches, not a split backfield. If Walker is limited, this is the proven Week 11 workload.

takeaways.title: The strip was not a takeaway
takeaways.body: Karlaftis forced the fumble on the sack at Q3 10:30. Fryar recovered it for Arizona. Both clubs finished with zero turnovers. Credit the pressure, not a turnover.

takeaways.title: Third down moved
takeaways.body: Kansas City was 7-of-13 after 4-of-13 in Atlanta. Arizona was 5-of-13 and stalled on downs twice. That down-and-distance jump is the useful carry into a Bills game, not the final margin.

whatWorked: Mahomes at 27-of-39, 324 yards, 3 touchdowns, a 120.0 rating, one sack, and five hits, with team net passing of 317.
Kelce's 6 catches, 74 yards, and 2 touchdowns, including the 22-yard score at Q2 1:54.
Karlaftis' 2.5 sacks and 7 team quarterback hits, with Arizona at 205 total yards.
Zero giveaways and 7-of-13 on third down across 10 drives.
whatDidnt: Team rushing stayed at 118 yards on 31 attempts even with Johnson at 105.
Mahomes' intentional grounding at Q2 0:16 backed the offense off the Arizona 16 before the half.
McBride still logged 10 touches; volume to a tight end is a warning even when the opponent finishes at 130 net passing yards.
J. Hicks' illegal block above the waist at Q4 13:30 was a self-inflicted flag after the lead was already 34-7.

currentState.lede: The club is 8-2 with three straight wins, tied with Denver for the AFC West lead, and walking into Buffalo as a three-point underdog. The Arizona afternoon was efficient. The roster questions that matter on Thu Nov 26 are tackle depth, Walker's limited return, and whether the Johnson workload is the plan or the bridge.

workOn.title: Tackle availability before an improved Bills rush
workOn.body: Arrowhead Pride's matchup questions lead with whether the offensive line can hold up against Buffalo's improved pass rush, and note coverage issues on the other side of that defense. Fred Johnson's promotion to the active roster is the concrete response to tackle concerns, not a finished answer. Mahomes took one sack and five hits against Arizona; Buffalo will not be that pocket.

workOn.title: Early-down run fits for Cook
workOn.body: Jones has named Cook the priority. Arizona gained 75 rushing yards on 21 attempts. That number does not travel. Spagnuolo has to decide how often the second level rallies versus how often Karlaftis and Jones stay in the rush, because Allen punishes a defense that sells out on one or the other.

workOn.title: Red-zone and third-down identity without assuming Walker
workOn.body: Johnson just carried 23 times. Walker is limited, not cleared in the supplied Tuesday report. Bieniemy needs a script that does not require a second featured back to be available on a short week.

thinkAbout.title: Is 46.6 percent the honest read?
thinkAbout.body: FPI has Kansas City at 46.6 and Buffalo at 53.1, with DraftKings at Bills minus 3 and a 46.5 total. The Arizona margin can talk fans into a favorite. The market and the model did not.

thinkAbout.title: How much of the West is this game?
thinkAbout.body: Arrowhead Pride has Denver holding a slight edge in a tied AFC West. A loss in Buffalo does not end the division. It does hand the Broncos another week of separation before Kansas City plays the Rams on Thu Dec 3, 7:15 PM CT.

thinkAbout.title: Downs as a real piece, not a box-score extra
thinkAbout.body: He had 4 catches against Arizona. The Week 12 power-rankings roundup on Arrowhead Pride flags him as an extension candidate while ESPN's sampling has Kansas City at 3. That is a usage question for Buffalo's coverage issues, not a trophy.

gamePlan.lede: Win the Cook downs, keep Allen out of the easy middle, and give Mahomes a moving picture against a pass rush Arrowhead Pride calls improved. Kansas City is catching three on Thu Nov 26, 7:20 PM CT at Buffalo on NBC. The rivalry note from Arrowhead Pride is the stakes: Buffalo has won five consecutive regular-season meetings.
gamePlan.howTheyMatch: Buffalo's identity in this matchup, as framed by the club's own voices and the Pride preview, is Allen plus Cook, with a defense that can rush and has coverage issues to attack. Kansas City just put up 435 yards and 7-of-13 on third down with zero giveaways, led by Mahomes' 3 touchdown passes and Johnson's 27 touches. The mismatch risk is not Arizona's 130 net passing yards repeating. It is Cook stressing the same linebacker fits that still allowed McBride 10 touches, and Allen holding the ball against a rush that has not sacked him often when Jones is on the field. Spagnuolo's Cover-2 and simulated pressure are the structural answers. Bieniemy's answers are inside zone on early downs, screens if the rush sells out, and mesh or a boot if Buffalo plays man and heat.

keys.title: Cook before Allen
keys.body: Jones said it. Fit the run with Bolton and the second level so Allen is throwing on schedule, not off a plus-run down. Do not treat a sack total against Allen as the grade.

keys.title: Make the Bills' coverage play the intermediate crossers
keys.body: Pride's questions piece says the Bills defense has coverage issues even with a better rush. Kelce (6 for 74 and 2 scores vs Arizona), Rice (6 catches), and Downs (4) are the crossers and sits. Worthy is the vertical alert, not the first read.

keys.title: Protect the tackle spots
keys.body: Johnson is on the active roster because tackle concerns are real. One sack and five hits was the Arizona pressure line. Boot and screen are the calls if that edge speed shows up early, not a hero dropback on every third-and-long.

keys.title: Do not donate the explosive
keys.body: Arizona's one touchdown was a 2-yard score after a 25-yard catch by Harrison Wallace. Buffalo does not need a 14-play drive if Allen gets a free shot. Two-deep is the shell until the down-and-distance says otherwise.

script: Open with under-center inside zone to Johnson, the same family as the up-the-middle and right-end carries that built the 14-0 lead, and keep Ott as the change-up rather than a featured split.
If Walker is active off a limited Tuesday, use him as a series change, not a required early-down starter. The proven carry count is Johnson's.
On second-and-manageable, call mesh with Kelce and Rice crossing and Downs as the sit, with Johnson as the checkdown. That is an answer to man coverage and to a rush that Pride says has improved.
Steal a possession with a screen to Johnson or Ott if the edge is crashing. Mahomes took five hits with one sack against Arizona; do not wait for a third-and-12 to take the pressure off.
Use a boot as a called concept to move the pocket, not as a label for anything on the Arizona tape. Put Kelce on the shallow cross and Worthy on the wheel or alert.
Defensively, start Cover-2 on early downs to cap Allen's deep middle, then call a zone blitz on a clear passing down — show heat, drop a lineman, rush the second level. That card is a call.

spotlight.title: Five straight regular-season losses to Buffalo are the backdrop
spotlight.body: Arrowhead Pride's Kingdom Keys put the split in plain language: Buffalo has won five consecutive regular-season meetings and holds a 5-1 edge before January in this era. The 8-2 record does not erase that ledger.

spotlight.title: Johnson's 27 touches are the current identity
spotlight.body: Bieniemy has talked about balancing Walker and Johnson. Walker's Tuesday report is limited. The tape that just happened is 23 carries, 105 yards, and a 3-yard score for Johnson.

spotlight.title: Jones has already named Cook
spotlight.body: In a 10th meeting with Allen, Jones has one sack and three tackles for loss in those games, per Arrowhead Pride. He still called Cook the No. 1 goal. That is the defensive story of the week.

spotlight.title: Fred Johnson is the tackle add
spotlight.body: Pride and Arrowhead Addict both have the Chiefs signing tackle Fred Johnson to the active roster off the practice squad, with tackle concerns the reason. He is depth, not a declared starter.

spotlight.title: The number moved to 46.5, and Kansas City is still catching points
spotlight.body: DraftKings lists Buffalo minus 3 on a 46.5 total. FPI is 46.6 to 53.1. Treat the Arizona 34-7 as context, not as a reason to fade the underdog tag.

matchups.unit: Chiefs run defense vs James Cook
matchups.chiefs: Chris Jones, Nick Bolton, Steve Spagnuolo
matchups.opponent: James Cook and the Bills run game
matchups.note: Jones called Cook the No. 1 goal. Arizona's 75 rushing yards do not measure this back. Edge to Buffalo until the fits show otherwise.

matchups.unit: Mahomes vs the Bills pass rush
matchups.chiefs: Patrick Mahomes, with Fred Johnson as new tackle depth
matchups.note: Pride's questions piece leads with the line holding up against an improved rush and grants Buffalo coverage issues. Arizona pressure was 1 sack and 5 hits. Expect more heat.

matchups.unit: Kelce and Rice vs Bills coverage
matchups.chiefs: Travis Kelce, Rashee Rice, Josh Downs
matchups.opponent: Bills coverage, described by Pride as a problem area
matchups.note: Kelce had 6 catches for 74 yards and 2 touchdowns; Rice had 6 catches; Downs had 4. If the rush is the Bills' strength, the intermediate catch volume is Kansas City's answer.

matchups.unit: Karlaftis and the rush vs Josh Allen
matchups.chiefs: George Karlaftis (2.5 sacks vs Arizona), Chris Jones
matchups.note: Karlaftis just posted 2.5 sacks and forced a fumble Arizona recovered. Jones' career ledger versus Allen in these meetings is one sack. Pressure can be real without a sack finishing the story.

matchups.unit: Early-down offense vs a short-week front
matchups.note: Johnson earned the carries. Team rushing was still 118 on 31 attempts. Buffalo will load the box if the boot and screen never show up.

matchups.opponent: A Bills defense with coverage issues and a better rush
matchups.note: The third-down jump from Atlanta's 4-of-13 to 7-of-13 is the trend line. It has to survive a better rush than Josh Johnson's afternoon.

xsandos.title: Johnson inside zone to open the series
xsandos.situation: 1st-and-10 early, Buffalo loading to hit Mahomes after a one-sack Arizona afternoon
xsandos.why: Johnson just ran 23 times for 105 yards, including the 3-yard score up the middle and the 16-yard right-end gain that started the first drive. Bieniemy can live on that identity while Walker is only limited on Tuesday, and it keeps Fred Johnson's new tackle snaps from being a pure pass-pro test.
xsandos.coaching: Zone steps, one cut, declare the crease. Johnson presses the play-side hip and bends only if the linebacker overruns. Ott is the change-up, not the first call. Do not wait for a second back to be healthy.

playmakers.name: Fred Johnson
playmakers.role: tackle help on the zone combo if active

xsandos.title: Screen the crashing edge
xsandos.situation: 2nd-and-6 after Buffalo shows the improved rush Pride flagged
xsandos.why: Mahomes absorbed five quarterback hits and one sack against Arizona. A screen to Johnson, who had four catches, or Ott lets the line get upfield and punishes a Bills rush that sells out to hit the quarterback.
xsandos.coaching: Let the end crash. Mahomes sells the drop for one hitch, then delivers to the back outside the crashing hip. Downs and Rice stalk the nearest coverage defender. Do not throw it into a vacated box just because the rush is loud.

xsandos.title: Mesh Kelce and Rice against man
xsandos.situation: 3rd-and-5, Bills in man with a rush look
xsandos.why: Pride says Buffalo's coverage has issues even as the rush has improved. Kelce (2 touchdowns, 74 yards) and Rice (6 catches) are the rub pair. Downs, with 4 catches and a power-rankings mention as an extension candidate, is the sit.
xsandos.coaching: Kelce and Rice cross at depth with a legal rub, not a hold. Mahomes' first read is the crosser who clears the linebacker, then Downs sitting, then Johnson on the checkdown. If the rush wins the edge, throw the outlet. Do not hold it for Worthy.

xsandos.title: Boot to move the launch point
xsandos.situation: 2nd-and-medium after a Johnson inside run, Bills edge crashing inside
xsandos.why: The Arizona tape does not label a play fake. The reason to call it now is an improved Bills rush and a new tackle in Fred Johnson: move Mahomes off the spot and give Kelce the easy cross he just scored on from the pocket.
xsandos.coaching: Sell the Johnson path, then boot Mahomes to the open edge. Kelce works the shallow cross. Worthy is the alert over the top, the same player who was targeted deep left late in the half. If the end squeezes, throw the cross. If he widens, keep it.

xsandos.title: Cover-2 to cap Allen and rally to Cook
xsandos.situation: 1st-and-10, Bills in 11 personnel, Cook the declared priority
xsandos.why: Jones said the No. 1 goal is Cook. Two deep takes the free shot away from Allen, the shot Arizona never really had while finishing at 130 net passing yards. The five underneath have to tackle. McBride's 10 touches are the reminder that a tight end or back can still eat in a low-yardage game.
xsandos.coaching: Spagnuolo: corners sink, safeties stay on top of Allen's deep middle. Bolton and the linebackers rally to Cook without vacating the hook. Karlaftis rushes his side but the call is coverage first. Do not turn this shell into a one-gap guess the play-by-play has not named.

xsandos.title: Zone blitz on a clear passing down
xsandos.situation: 2nd-and-long or 3rd-and-6, Allen in the gun, Cook not the primary threat on that down
xsandos.why: This is a call to use against Allen, not a claim about the Arizona strip. Karlaftis forced a fumble that Fryar recovered; the box still shows zero turnovers. Simulated pressure lets Spagnuolo show heat, drop a lineman, and rush a second-level player so Allen throws before Cook can leak out.
xsandos.coaching: Show four, rush three, drop Jones or the end into the hook Cook would use as a checkdown. The second-level rusher has to be on time. If Allen pulls it down, the dropped lineman is the force player. Grade the call on whether Allen is on schedule, not on a takeaway.

playmakers.name: Chris Jones
playmakers.role: rush or drop depending on the picture
